caseNameFull: Turnock, Director of the Illinois Department of Public Health v. Ragsdale

opinions.text:
C. A. 7th Cir. [Probable jurisdiction postponed, 492 U. S. 916.] Motion of Alan Ernest for leave to represent children unborn and born alive denied. Motion of Legal Defense for Unborn Children for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae denied. Motion of Larry Joyce for leave to participate in oral argument as amicus curiae, for divided argument, and for additional time for oral argument denied.

Justice Stevens took no part in the consideration or decision of these motions.
